reuse.reason: The pinned official entry-customization plugin has no SaaS account prerequisite contract and hides Browse other plugins without pluginNavigation. This complete pinned fork preserves all three official menu registrations, dictionaries and CSS. A real public or authenticated pluginNavigation service opens Browse other plugins; Create your plugin opens the login dialog for anonymous visitors and otherwise keeps the official Creator draft flow. Checking/error states remain guarded; no RemoteAccess grant or private session is fabricated.
gaps: Anonymous More actions stay clickable: Browse opens the public plugin catalog, Create asks for sign-in before creating a private draft. Missing navigation, checking and error states keep localized unavailable semantics.
All official menu rows, icons, labels and geometry remain unchanged; no About, Support or Environment entries are added.
Anonymous Creator defers the login request one animation frame so the unchanged official Menu can restore focus to its persistent trigger before the dialog captures it.
This revision limits the workbench to authenticated accounts. The anonymous homepage uses the isolated sign-in and consent document providers.
